reviews.text: Very nice and caring vets and nurses. Good communication over Whatsapp.
Thank you, Eddie - so pleased you had a great experience with us!

Went in a few months ago for a blood test for my large dog, when I arrived in our appointed time there was no one in the clinic and I had to wait 10 minutes until a nurse arrived and opened the clinic. It was a hot day so felt like 40 degrees inside. The nurse was nice and apologised for the delay, but she tried to get blood from 7 different spots, shaved my dog in both front legs and both sides of his neck, just to later give up on getting his blood. Since then he refuses to enter the clinic so we take him to the London fields one, where everything goes smooth.

Lovely vetenary clinic. Very calm environment.
Friendly staff and very professional.
I recommend this vet to cats and kittens in the DeBeauvoir area🐈‍⬛

Thanks to all at this wonderful vets saying goodbye to our beautiful Jessy after 14 years was made a lot easier by the warmth and kindness showed by the vet and nurse. Sorry forget names,will be forever greatfull  to you both❤️
Tracey, Eva and Jessy💙 …

Excellent service. Great communication, get back to you so quickly and very easy to book appointments. Vet was great with my lively cat. And the whatsapp service is auch a bonus. Allows you to check minor things without booking a while visit and spending lots of money.

Great location and lovely staff. We’ve just enjoyed one of the free puppy vet socialisation classes with Alex and team. This was a useful opportunity for our puppy to meet others around his age in a calm environment. My only request is for these puppy sessions to be moved to a later weekday slot (eg 5-6pm) or to a weekend so we can attend more regularly!!

This was my first time visiting hello vet and I was so impressed with the space and service that me and my dog received!
Everything was clean and spacious and this was probably the first time my dog has not been anxious when I’ve taken him to a vet. We came for my dog’s annual vaccines and check up.
We had such a calm and good experience.
Pre and post care are fantastic! The venue is gorgeous and the service + care is top notche!

I took my cat here to have her nails clipped and was so impressed. The staff were so incredibly gentle, and the whole experience made her feel very comfortable and at ease.Its such a relief to find a vet who know how to handle cats so well. Highly recommended for a stress free visit!

Outstanding care, expertise, service and environment. So grateful to this excellent practice for the exceptionally high standards and sensitive and proactive approach. Fellini and I are eternally thankful to the whole fabulous team-all superstars. 💫⭐️ …

I took my cat Tesla to Hello Vet De Beauvoir for her first vaccinations and had a great experience. The team was incredibly kind, patient, and clearly genuine animal lovers.
They explained everything in detail, answered all my questions, and handled Tesla with such care and gentleness that she stayed calm the whole time. They even gave her a treat she loved, which made the visit even more positive.
The clinic is clean, welcoming, and very professional. I highly recommend them to any pet owner looking for a caring and trustworthy vet.

A really friendly, welcoming space, that really reduces the stress that my dog feels in going to the vets.

Both the vets we've seen so far at the clinic have been extremely knowledgeable, understanding and patient, especially with my slightly nervous dog.

I also appreciate the proactivity in giving advice, following up after appointments and generally making you feel that your pet is getting the full attention they deserve.

Highly recommended!

We had a great experience at Hello Vet. Dr Joe was very helpful and took the time to answer all of my questions. We’ve just moved to London, so it was important for me to find a clinic where I felt my little guy would be in good hands and stay on schedule with any upcoming vaccinations.

The clinic itself is very warm, inviting, and honestly just adorable 🥰. The whole experience felt calm, welcoming, and professional. I’m really glad we found Hello Vet and feel confident bringing my pup here.

Amazing practice, the facilities are the best Ive seen, so calming for both pets and pet owners. We took our very anxious cat and Dr Odile treated her with calm and care. Appointments are easy to book through whatsapp. Highly recommend this place!

The team were incredibly friendly and very professional. Practise is very modern, clean and ascetically pleasing for dog and human alike. Pay what you need, nothing you don’t! Our pooch now wants to go to the vets each time we walk past!

Hello Bruna
Thanks for taking the time to leave us a review, we appreciate it! If you need anything at all, just reach out on WhatsApp. 
Best wishes, Hannah

I had an outstanding experience with this vet practice. Team was welcoming, patient and incredibly caring. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a vet who treats your pet like a family.

Amazing vet and team. They treat Frida with so much love and care, and always make me feel comfortable and reassured. You can tell they truly care about pets and their people. I wouldn’t take Frida anywhere else. Highly recommend ❤️🐾
We are very happy with this new location, beautiful space and closer to us!!!! …
LOVE the team here. It was such an easy registration process and it's a great location and facility.

I brought my very vet adverse senior husky here for a senior checkup and blood work. We’re new to London and the neighborhood so I didn’t know what to expect. From the moment I arrived the overall experience felt serene and relaxed. There were treats available in the waiting area and it was extremely clean. The vet took great care with my dog to make her feel safe and comfortable. The whole visit was extremely smooth and the communication and follow up after was top notch. I would highly recommend especially if you have an anxious dog!
